title: Brand Name Pencils
content: Bob Truby loves pencils so much that he has made a comprehensive website calledBrand Name Pencils, where you can search all the known brands or types, including theEl Dorado, which Imentioned on a previous post.He's got aMost Wantedpage of rare pencils that he's looking for and willing to buy from you. Maybe there's gold in the back of your art supply drawer.----Thanks, Paulo
